chunks: Hadith 1774 — The Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله said to his companions: “Shall I not inform you of something which, if you do it, Shaytan will be distanced from you as the east is distanced from the west?” They said: “Yes, O Messenger of Allah.”

He said: “Fasting blackens his face, charity breaks his back, love for the sake of Allah, Mighty and Majestic, and mutual support in righteous deed cut off his remnant, and seeking forgiveness severs his life-vein. For everything there is a zakat, and the zakat of bodies is fasting.”

key_terms.الصَّدَقَةُ: charity given for Allah’s sake, described as breaking Shaytan’s back
key_terms.الصَّوْمُ: sawm; fasting as an act that subdues Shaytan
key_terms.الصِّيَامُ: fasting, here described as the purification of bodies
key_terms.الْحُبُّ فِي اللَّهِ: love for the sake of Allah; sincere faith-based affection
key_terms.الْعَمَلِ الصَّالِحِ: righteous deed; conduct pleasing to Allah
key_terms.الْمُؤَازَرَةُ: mutual support and assistance, here in righteous deeds
key_terms.زَكَاةٌ: purification; the cleansing due for a thing

ai.seo_question: How does fasting and righteous action distance Shaytan from a person?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches that acts of worship and virtue weaken Shaytan’s influence over the believer. It highlights sawm, charity, love for the sake of Allah, cooperation in righteous deeds, and seeking forgiveness as powerful means of spiritual protection and purification.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications:
Hadith.1774 - The Messenger of Allah (swt) (peace and blessings be upon him and his family) said to his companions:
"Shall I not inform you of something that, if you do it, will cause Satan to be distanced from you as far as the east is from the west?"
They said: "Yes, O Messenger of Allah (swt)."

The Prophet (sw) said: "Fasting blackens his face, charity breaks his back, love for the sake of Allah (swt), the Almighty, and mutual support in good deeds cut off his roots, and seeking forgiveness cuts off his aorta. For everything, there is a purification, and the purification of the body is fasting."
